description: Track inventory SKUs with on-hand quantities, reservations, and reorder points; adjust stock, reserve/release units, and report low-stock items. Real arithmetic — stock is never invented.
name: inventory_check
provider_notes: Local JSON-backed store via ctx.memory (key aul:inventory_v1). No warehouse/ERP provider integrated. Stock numbers reflect only what was recorded through this module — never inferred or fabricated. Demo runs against an in-memory FakeCtx, clearly labeled.
